notes: Compiled Ren'Py game files (.rpa archives / .rpyc scripts, normally under game/, hence the depth-2 search) for distributions shipping without the renpy/ runtime dir - enginehost's existing fallback. A separate LATE row rather than part of the renpy row so the cheap runtime-dir check stays first and every more specific engine above outranks this looser evidence.

saves.source: renpy.py path_to_saves (no config.save_directory: <game>/saves; else %APPDATA%/RenPy/<dir>, ~/.renpy/<dir>, ~/Library/RenPy/<dir>) and renpy/savelocation.py init (adds <game>/saves); under Enginehost the 8.3 line's renpy.py path_to_saves (ENGINEHOST_SAVE_PATH/<save_directory>, else the game folder's name); all in the enginehost-renpy-plugin repo
